description: Propose a different fee on a pending booking offer (posts an amended offer card in chat, retiring the old one). expected_current_fee must match the booking; the new fee must stay within 50-200% of it, and only one counter per booking per day. Requires the member's "Allow my assistant to act" switch.

booking_id.description: The booking id from a my_bookings result.

expected_current_fee.description: The fee currently on the booking (GBP).

new_fee.description: The proposed fee (GBP), within 50-200% of the current fee.

note.description: Optional short message to accompany the counter.

name: counter_booking
title: Counter a booking offer
